claims.claim: GPT-5.6 Sol Standard on OpenAI's own API is priced at $5.00 per million input tokens and $30.00 per million output tokens as of Aug 18, 2026.
GPT-5.6 Sol is listed at $2.50 per million input and $15 per million output tokens (50% off) on OpenRouter's OpenAI provider endpoint as of Aug 18, 2026.
GPT-5.6 Sol is listed at $2.50 per million input and $15 per million output tokens (standard tier) on Vercel's AI Gateway as of Aug 18, 2026.
Azure and Amazon Bedrock providers serving GPT-5.6 Sol through OpenRouter still list $5.00-$5.50 input / $30-$33 output (no 50% discount) as of Aug 18, 2026.
On July 30, 2026, OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 Luna prices by 80% and GPT-5.6 Terra prices by 20% on its own API while leaving GPT-5.6 Sol Standard unchanged at $5/$30.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman announced the July 30 cuts on X as 'major price cuts today', referring to the Luna and Terra reductions.
OpenRouter's dedicated OpenAI Flex endpoint for GPT-5.6 Sol lists $1.25 input / $7.50 output per million tokens, i.e. 50% below OpenAI's own API Flex price of $2.50/$15.
OpenRouter's weekly token rankings as of Aug 18, 2026 show DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 at 11.3T tokens, Tencent Hy3 at 9.7T, GPT-5.6 Luna at 5.57T, and six of the top ten slots held by Chinese labs.
GPT-5.6 Sol is not among the top ten models by weekly tokens on OpenRouter as of Aug 18, 2026; GPT-5.6 Luna is OpenAI's only top-ten entrant.
On Aug 17, 2026, GPT-5.6 Sol processed roughly 736 billion prompt tokens and ~19.6 million requests on OpenRouter.
Grok 4.6 (launched Aug 12, 2026) scores 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, matching GPT-5.6 Sol's score of 61.

TD Cowen analysis of OpenRouter data (reported by Business Insider) found Luna's effective price fell ~10x with usage up ~14x and OpenAI Luna revenue up ~34% vs the pre-cut week; Terra's effective price fell ~3x with usage up ~5x and revenue up ~45%.
Ramp data (reported by Business Insider) shows OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol captured more business spending in July 2026 than Anthropic's Fable 5.

OpenRouter reported weekly token volume growth from 5 trillion to 25 trillion tokens in six months (May 2026), serving 8M+ developers across 400+ models and pacing toward a quadrillion tokens per year.
Stripe agreed to buy OpenRouter for more than $7 billion (Bloomberg); Axios reported an $8 billion price; WSJ reported talks at roughly $10 billion in July 2026.
a16z owns more than 17% of OpenRouter (roughly $20M invested) and would net close to $1.5 billion if the sale closes near $8 billion; Menlo Ventures holds >6% worth more than $500 million.
DeepSeek raised V4-Flash and V4-Pro API prices effective Aug 17, 2026, with increases from 50% to 1,100% under a peak/off-peak schedule (V4-Pro peak cache-hit input +1,100%).
OpenAI said it surpassed 1 billion active users in late July 2026, the same week it announced the GPT-5.6 price cuts.
Vercel's AI Gateway charges no markup and no platform fee on tokens, billing at the provider's list price (pass-through).

The channel-restricted 50% discount on GPT-5.6 Sol (OpenRouter and Vercel only, direct API unchanged) indicates OpenAI is pricing to win token share in third-party routing channels rather than responding to a demand curve on its own API.
